# Release version: 0.2.20

• Read positions now synchronize across connected devices, with retries for
  failed acknowledgements and fewer repeated notifications.
• Fixed missing direct-message alerts, mobile call audio, and the DM call screen.
• Improved saved-session reliability and fixed a Linux video playback crash.
• Added AutoMod controls, upload review states, and clearer rate-limit guidance.
• Improved mobile channel permissions and space menus, and added easy access
  to the Privacy Policy.
• Fixed the local MCP connection handshake for desktop tools.
